scope: Read-only regression for programming-node base-boundary composition; no new placement/routing claims
historical_receipt_limits: Existing receipt proves old lower-only role equality and complete-pair role compilation, not native placement, routing or current acceptance. Four boards compiled a pair; Hub refused missing closed court; PCIe2 had no positive role; three daughterboards had no applicable pair.
identity_result: All native-derived boundary requests were returned exactly unchanged with no extras/proofs when retired_track_uuids was empty. Packet inputs, source RAM native binding, source PCB SHA and historical receipt SHA remained unchanged.
limitation: This is no-cut packet identity, not a new source-owned ordinary-role or placement proof. It deliberately avoids new selected poses, high-cost source export scans and DRC/refills.

focused_tests.positive_programming_matrix: 4 quarter turns x2 board faces x3 retained-port cases (none, via, third trace) =24 positive cases, including reversed demand endpoint order; every actual surviving native component port remains required.
focused_tests.negative_coverage: Source selection forgery, missing role, supply/Ground pad substitution, narrow/wider demand, changed native width/contact, stale source binding, incomplete ownership, distinct joins, Ground and already-extra composition remain refused or unchanged as specified.
